message.body: We have done everything possible on our side; there is simply no more room in this price. We remain at your disposal for the order.
Your last proposal was, quite honestly, an insult to our people. We have nevertheless revised our offer once more.
Thank you for the proposal. Our sales manager has to sign off on anything below list price; I expect his answer by Thursday.
Before we continue: two of our invoices from August are still unpaid, which is putting real strain on us.
Payment terms are not the issue for us at all; our cash position is comfortable. The issue is the steel price, which rose 9 % since spring.
Our presses are booked out until the end of the year, so new parts would join a waiting list.
We currently have idle hours on our CNC line and could take on further parts at short notice.
If you could commit to a three-year agreement, we would be able to invest in a dedicated tool and lower the unit price.
Ehrlich gesagt sind wir von Ihrem Vorschlag enttäuscht. Wir bleiben aber gesprächsbereit.
Diesen Preis kann ich nicht allein entscheiden; ich bespreche ihn morgen mit unserem Inhaber.
I hear that you also asked our competitors. They will not match our quality. Our offer stands as revised below.
Wir haben unser Angebot nochmals geprüft. Mehr ist für uns leider nicht möglich. Wir würden uns dennoch über den Auftrag freuen.
